answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake that is slashed when duplicate behavior is proven, and to earn reputation only through verified completed work. A falcon-eyed audit trail links each job to one stake, so creating a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand stakes and paying for a thousand work histories. Like crossing a frozen tundra, each fake step costs real energy and time, and a single jade seal of verified identity per stake makes cheap mass forgery unprofitable.
